title: Docker Compose example test: retry only `docker compose pull`, and run logs and cleanup from an EXIT trap
answers: Why does the artifacts example integration test fail when Docker Hub times out pulling postgres?
Where is the retry logic for transient Docker image pulls in the MLflow artifacts integration test?
If I add another step to the Docker compose example test, will its cleanup still run when it fails?
How do I make the example test stop on build or application errors without retrying them?
body:
Path: tests/tracking/test_mlflow_artifacts.py:test_mlflow_artifacts_example writes a shell script that runs `docker compose pull --ignore-buildable`, `./build.sh`, and `docker compose run ... python example.py` for the artifacts example, then collects logs and tears down containers and images.
Rule: Retry only the registry step: `docker compose pull` runs up to 3 times with 5s and 10s sleeps, and the script fails after the third attempt. Build and application commands are not retried. The script uses `set -e` so build or app failures stop immediately. Put logs and `docker compose down {rmi_option} --volumes --remove-orphans` in an `EXIT` trap, not after the commands, so they run exactly once on success, on exhausted pulls, and on failures. The trap captures `status=$?` first and sets `status=1` only if log collection or cleanup itself fails, so the original nonzero exit code is preserved.
Symptom: The CI job for the artifacts example failed when Docker Hub's auth endpoint timed out while pulling `postgres`. Earlier versions also skipped cleanup on failure, because a plain `exit` or a failed command bypassed the trailing `docker compose down`, so images pulled before the failure were not removed on GitHub Actions.
Constraints: Applies to this generated shell script in the Docker-based artifacts example test. Do not add retries around build or application commands, since those failures are not transient registry errors. The `--rmi all` cleanup is only added when `is_github_actions()` is true.
applies: Docker Compose-based integration tests in tests/tracking that generate a shell script with set -e and cleanup; not for unit tests or non-Docker tests.
says: Artifacts example integration test fails intermittently when image downloads time out in continuous integration.
Failed integration test runs leave leftover container images and volumes behind on build workers.
Automatically retry downloading container images without retrying failing application or build steps.
Ensure container logs and resources are always cleaned up even if test steps fail.
Network timeouts during container setup cause the entire integration test run to fail permanently.
search: The Docker Compose artifacts integration test in tests/tracking/test_mlflow_artifacts.py retries docker compose pull up to three times with sleeps while leaving build and application commands unretried under set -e. Container log collection and docker compose down cleanup run from an EXIT trap to ensure teardown occurs exactly once and preserves non-zero exit codes on failure. Container image removal via --rmi all in cleanup is added only when is_github_actions() returns true, applying solely to this generated shell script.
